settings.title: Our Story
settings.rich_text: Born in 2024 in Barcelona, Spain, Gudslip® is more than just a provider of sleep solutions. We are innovators inspired by popular American trends in sleep technology. Our mission is simple: to enhance your nights and transform your days through better sleep.

We, two young brothers, were deeply inspired by the profound impact of something as fundamental as breathwork. This realization led us to create Gudslip®. We recognized that basic actions like breathing could significantly alter one's quality of life, and thus, we set out to develop products that enhance nightly breathing, putting individuals in control of their own well-being.

As a family-run business, we believe wellness should be straightforward and accessible. We hold the conviction that true empowerment arises from a deep understanding and management of our basic behaviors, rather than through complex interventions. Our products are designed to unlock your inner potential by focusing on simple, yet essential, actions. Inspired by nature and effective practices from around the globe, Gudslip® aims to not only improve your sleep and health but also demonstrate that the key to a fulfilling life lies within mastering the basics.

settings.title: Restful Foundations
settings.rich_text: At Gudslip®, our values revolve around enhancing life through better sleep. We emphasize empowerment by equipping individuals with tools for improved well-being. Integrity guides our operations, ensuring transparency and honesty. Our commitment is to impact lives positively, providing products that foster both better sleep and personal growth.

settings.title: All Sleep Gud
settings.rich_text:
Our slogan, "All Sleep Gud," encapsulates our commitment to transforming nights for everyone, particularly in households where snoring is a common challenge. It's not uncommon for one partner's snoring to disrupt the other's sleep, leading to restless nights and strained days for both. With Gudslip®, we address this issue head-on.

Our mouth tape is designed to gently encourage nasal breathing, which naturally reduces snoring. By minimizing this disruptive sleep behavior, both the individual wearing the tape and their partner can enjoy uninterrupted, restful sleep. The slogan "All Sleep Gud" reflects this harmony and shared benefit. It’s not just about improving sleep for the snorer; it’s about enhancing sleep for everyone in the bed. With Gudslip®, couples can reclaim their nights, waking up refreshed and revitalized, together. Every night, in every home using our product, we make good on the promise that "All Sleep Gud."

Beyond Sleep Aids

At Gudslip®, we’re not just in the business of selling sleep aids; we’re in the business of restoring peace and tranquility to your nights. Our products are more than just tools; they are keys to unlocking a world of restful sleep and mornings filled with vitality. Our nose strips and mouth tapes are designed to ensure that every user, and their partners, experience the profound benefits of uninterrupted sleep—benefits that extend well beyond the night.

Transparent as Air, Comforting as Home

Embodying the spirit of innovation and transparency, every Gudslip® product is a testament to our commitment to quality and honesty. We use materials that are safe, effective, and designed to provide comfort without complication. There are no hidden ingredients or unnecessary additives—just simple, effective solutions crafted to meet the highest standards.

Our Commitment to You

Our journey is a collective endeavor aimed at improving how you live and sleep. It’s a shared mission to make nights better and days brighter, enhancing overall well-being with every product we offer. Join us on this splendid journey to redefine what it means to wake up refreshed and ready to embrace the day.

Because at Gudslip®, we’re not just crafting sleep solutions. We’re crafting a new beginning for you.
